title: Web Developer | Front-End
description:
Aqui na Nelogica, desenvolvemos tecnologias e pessoas de alta performance com o propósito de transformar o futuro do mercado financeiro!

Você tem sede de desafios e está a fim de fazer parte de um time que busca a excelência, impactando diretamente milhares de usuários? Estamos sempre com posições abertas nas mais diversas frentes de atuação, para desenvolvedores apaixonados por transformar inteligência em código!

Nossos times Web atuam com o desenvolvimento dos nossos sites, sistemas de gestão para corretoras parceiras e também para processos internos da empresa, além de produtos como o Akeloo, InvestDay home brokers e as versões web e MacOS de nossos principais softwares: Profit, Vector e BlackArrow.

As principais atividades são:

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações web com foco em alta performance, escalabilidade e experiência do usuário;
  • Participar de projetos envolvendo diferentes stacks e frameworks, como JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue.js, PHP, CSS, entre outros;
  • Implementar interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas, garantindo usabilidade e compatibilidade entre navegadores e dispositivos;
  • Contribuir em projetos diversos, desde sites institucionais e plataformas educacionais até sistemas internos de gestão e portais de parceiros;
  • Apoiar a evolução contínua das soluções, identificando oportunidades de inovação tecnológica e aprimoramento da experiência do usuário.

O que é essencial que você apresente:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Física, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Desejo de trabalhar em um ambiente ágil e acelerado;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar de forma 100% presencial em Porto Alegre/RS.

O que é um diferencial:

  • Tiver conhecimento relacionado ao mercado financeiro (ex: ações, opções, renda fixa, macroeconomia, HFT, criptomoedas)
  • Envolvimento em projetos desafiadores e inovadores, com alto grau de complexidade (como projetos de pesquisa, mestrado, doutorado, ou P&D na indústria).

Consideramos como diferenciais experiências complementares além da atuação profissional, como o envolvimento acadêmico (PETs, mentorias, cursos, competições etc), ou envolvimento em comunidades de sua área de atuação, trabalho voluntário entre outros.

Além disso, por aqui jogamos juntos para promover um ambiente cada dia mais inclusivo, que valoriza todas as trajetórias independentemente de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia ou deficiência

title: Analista financeiro sênior
description:

Por meio da nossa área de Alocação de Talentos, você poderá colocar sua experiência em prática em contextos empresariais variados, contribuindo com nosso padrão de excelência em distintas operações e segmentos.

Ao ser alocado em uma de nossas demandas externas, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, colaborando diretamente para o sucesso de nossos clientes. Essa contribuição proporciona vivência prática e aprendizado constante. E você contará com o acompanhamento próximo da equipe Forvis Mazars, garantindo alinhamento ao longo de toda a sua atuação.

  • Monitorar indicadores de performance, inadimplência e recuperação de crédito, propondo planos de ação;

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em cobrança de carteiras de investimento, crédito corporativo ou financeiro;
  • Conhecimento prático de regras de PDD, fluxos de cobrança judicial e compliance financeiro;
  • Domínio de Excel avançado (indicadores, dashboards e modelagens analíticas);
  • Experiência com ERP TOTVS ou sistemas equivalentes;
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e com visão estratégica sobre processos financeiros;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Barueri/SP.

O que esperamos de você

  • Comprometimento com prazos, entregas e qualidade do trabalho;
  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes ambientes e rotinas corporativas;
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas e execução das atividades;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Responsabilidade, organização e adaptabilidade;
  • Disposição para colaborar com diferentes equipes e projetos;

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
Business Operations Associate

São Paulo, Brazil

About Divibank:

At Divibank, we are developing the leading platform for online businesses in Latin America, combining

payment solutions and access to capital. With our payment orchestration solution, we integrate multiple

payment methods to our subacquirer, helping businesses increase transaction approvals and improve

their sales by up to 22%, reduce costs and drive sustainable growth. Our mission is to be the go-to

partner for companies looking to expand efficiently, offering technology and personalized support in an

all-in-one platform.

This is a PJ hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in our office on Av Brigadeiro Faria Lima 1912.

About the role and team:

We are looking for a Business Operations Associate to join our dynamic team.

You will have the opportunity to drive the success of businesses in Brazil and play a critical role in

ensuring smooth operational processes, providing exceptional customer support, and fostering strong

relationships with our clients. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, and driven by

problem-solving. Our operations and customer success teams are the tip of the spear of our business,

with agile thinking and excellent communication to drive positive change for our customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the processes of proposal generation, KYC (Know Your Customer), and client

onboarding, ensuring agility and clear communication with all relevant teams.

  • Act as the main point of contact for customers, ensuring an efficient onboarding process,

addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive customer experience.

  • Oversee customer support operations using CX tools to triage, prioritize, and resolve tickets

quickly, delivering an exceptional customer experience that conveys trust and reliability.

  • Monitor transaction data and chargebacks, quickly identifying fraud risks and implementing

corrective actions.

  • Handle chargeback response cases, supporting clients to timely respond with the necessary

information.

  • Work together with our Treasury to ensure client settlements are working according to plan.
  • Run credit card receivable assignment operations, either for discounting or for collection

purposes.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies related to payment

operations.

  • Map and review operational workflows and data to identify gaps and propose improvements,

whether through process adjustments, the implementation of third-party tools, or development

suggestions for internal product and tech teams.

  • Collaborate with technology and product teams to troubleshoot and resolve operational issues in

a timely manner.

  • Proactively engage with customers to understand their needs and ensure their satisfaction with

our services.

  • Work closely with the sales and product teams to align customer success initiatives to optimize

customer journey

  • Track and report customer success metrics, including satisfaction rates, retention, and churn.

What qualifications we need:

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, customer success, or a related role, preferably within the

fintech, payments or consulting industries.

  • Bachelor's degree (completed or in progress) in relevant fields (Business Administration,

Engineering, etc.).

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-first mindset.
  • Proficiency in using customer relationship management (CRM) and operations tools.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong sense of ownership and business orientation
  • Positive, willing to get hands dirty and proactive attitude
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to prioritize in ambiguous situations
  • Working proficiency and communication skills in English (verbal and written)

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in Fintech or online Payments industry
  • Basic understanding of APIs or technical architecture to collaborate effectively with engineers
  • Knowledge of analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude or Looker.

Personal attitudes we look for:

  • You get sh*t done!
  • You do whatever it takes to get things moving and completed
  • You have an ownership mentality, are energetic, and bring the best out of others
  • You communicate clearly and concisely
  • You can adapt and explain complex subjects to different audiences
  • Everyone understands what your priorities and objectives are
  • You organize and break down complex problems into simple tasks

title: Senior Facilities Manager
description:
Primary Purpose of the Position

The Senior Facilities Manager is responsible for the strategic and operational management of the school's facilities, ensuring a safe, functional, and efficient environment for the school community. This professional coordinates the maintenance, electrical, civil, and operational support teams, as well as the outsourced contracts for gardening and cleaning services, ensuring service quality, meeting deadlines, and controlling costs. They plan and execute preventive and corrective maintenance programs, manage the department's budget, and ensure the legal compliance of the buildings.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • Directly manage the maintenance, electrical, civil, and operational support teams.
  • Manage outsourced contracts for gardening, cleaning, and other related services.
  • Plan and execute the annual preventive and corrective maintenance schedule.
  • Oversee, together with the Technical Construction Consultant, large-scale projects and interventions, ensuring alignment with quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Develop and control the department's budget, including operational costs and infrastructure investments.
  • Monitor the performance of vendors and contractors, ensuring the quality and efficiency of the services provided.
  • Develop and track facilities performance indicators (KPIs), such as costs, response time, and operational availability.
  • Keep all legal and technical building documentation up to date (e.g., fire department inspection certificate, accessibility reports, and other mandatory certifications).
  • Support inspections and audits.
  • Coordinate campus support activities such as events, sports, and material movement.
  • Ensure a safe and appropriate physical environment for both academic and administrative activities.
  • Promote the efficient use of campus spaces and resources, in alignment with other school departments.
  • Lead the Facilities team, fostering people management, performance evaluation, and professional development opportunities.
  • Support the Director of Business and Operations in strategic decisions related to infrastructure and investments.
  • Maintain effective communication with various departments, including academic areas, to ensure operational alignment and support for school activities

Certifications and Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering

Experience

Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência em gestão de facilities, manutenção predial ou áreas correlatas

Previous experience in the education sector or in complex service institutions- Desired

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Proficiency in English.

Strong leadership skills and ability to manage multidisciplinary teams.

Experience in budgeting, planning, and cost control.

Knowledge of safety, environmental, and building maintenance standards.

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture, thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client's product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience:Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals, file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue, S3, Redshift Spectrum, Lambda, and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow, Kafka, or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location: Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length: 1+ Year

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Role Summary

The Senior Backend Engineer is a crucial position within Vingcard | ASSA ABLOY, primarily responsible for designing, developing and maintaining robust backend solutions that power our innovative access control systems for hotels and adjacent markets. The role demands a deep understanding of backend technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin. The candidate will work in a dynamic, cross-functional team to deliver high-quality software that enhances the functionality and performance of our products.

  • Job Location: Brasilia, Brazil

KEY Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate user-facing elements using server-side logic.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle, from design to deployment.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize backend systems.
  • Ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of current backend technologies and best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing feedback and suggestions for improvement.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior developers, helping them navigate technical challenges and grow in their careers.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices in software engineering, including code quality, testing, and documentation.

Responsibilities And Authorities

  • Authority to make technical decisions related to software architecture and design.
  • Access to all necessary information and tools to perform role effectively.
  • Responsibility for delivering high-quality software solutions on time and within budget.
  • Authority to mentor and provide career development support to junior developers.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project assignments and career development.

Internal and External Contacts/Customers

  • Internal: Work closely with other software developers, QA engineers, product managers, and designers.
  • External: Interact with external stakeholders during product demos or user feedback sessions.

Skills

Key competencies, Relevant Knowledge, skills and competEncies

  • Proficient in Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Experience with observability technologies (e.g. Datadog).
  • Experience with Git versioning systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to manage time effectively.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in backend development.
  • Proven experience with Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Familiarity with Git versioning systems.

Languages

  • Proficiency in English for listening, reading and writing. Intermediate speaking skills in English. Proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese.

Computer Skills

  • Proficiency in software development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment pipelines.
  • Proficiency in Java/Kotlin.
  • Deep knowledge of Spring MVC and/or Spring Boot.
  • Proficiency in interacting with relational databases.
  • Working knowledge of distributed architectures and messaging systems (RabbitMQ, AMQP, etc).
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes, etc).

Experience

  • Software Engineer, Backend Engineer or similar position.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience.

Personal qualities

  • Strong leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead projects.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with a commitment to staying up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn new technologies and practices.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on code quality and best practices.

Expected outcome and deliverables -(For the role, on a 3-5 years horizon)

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Backend Engineer will contribute significantly to the development and optimization of our backend systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and efficient. The role will play a key part in enhancing the functionality of our access control solutions, delivering high-quality software that meets the needs of our customers and stays ahead of industry trends, including launching new products. The individual in this position will have the opportunity to grow professionally, acquiring new skills and taking on additional responsibilities as part of a dynamic and innovative team.

Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.

We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!

CONTRACT DETAILS

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

As we welcome new people on board, it's important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Coordenador(a) de PMO & Leads
description:
Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de PMO & Leads para liderar a criação da Célula de Inteligência e Captação de Leads — uma área estratégica responsável por consolidar dados, ferramentas e análises de performance, além de estruturar o processo de geração e tratamento de leads de franquias e expansão.

O(a) profissional será protagonista na definição de metodologias, indicadores e rituais de performance, garantindo a governança dos projetos e apoiando a alta gestão na tomada de decisões.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Estruturar a Célula de Inteligência e PMO, definindo processos, KPIs e rituais de acompanhamento.
  • Gerir ferramentas e sistemas da área (Power BI, CRM, Airtable, Geofusion, etc.), assegurando a integridade dos dados e o suporte às decisões estratégicas.
  • Monitorar e consolidar KPIs e BSC, liderando a cadência dos comitês e rituais de performance.
  • Elaborar análises de viabilidade e apresentações executivas, transformando dados complexos em materiais estratégicos para a alta liderança.
  • Mapear sinergias e oportunidades entre as unidades de negócio, identificando sobreposições de praças, performance de lojas e potenciais de novas aberturas.
  • Criar e implementar a Base de Leads de Expansão, automatizando o funil com o suporte de IA e parceiros digitais.
  • Supervisionar campanhas de captação de leads, aprovando pautas, artes e acompanhando resultados e investimentos.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável: MBA em Gestão de Negócios e/ou Finanças para Executivos.
  • Experiência desejável em: Gestão de portfólio imobiliário e negociações com grupos de shopping.
  • Excel avançado e domínio de Power BI.
  • Liderança de times, visão analítica e foco em resultados.
  • Local: Necessário residir em São Paulo/SP.

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes
  • Gestão de negócios e finanças
  • Gerenciamento de projetos (PMO)

Você terá a chance de construir uma área, com autonomia, protagonismo e contato direto com a alta gestão.

É uma posição estratégica para quem quer gerar impacto real na expansão e performance da empresa.

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.

Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.

Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.

We need tutors who can start immediately!

Characteristics

Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite

Requirements

  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.

Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

description:
Procuramos um(a) Consultor(a) de Sucesso do Cliente para criar uma relação de confiança com os clientes, entendendo suas necessidades e despertando o desejo de evoluir a gestão, por meio de compartilhamento das melhores práticas e orientações para que possam tomar decisões mais assertivas.

title: Fund Manager
description:
Fund Operations Manager (AMIF)

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil - On site

Company: Amicorp Fund Services

Are you an experienced fund professional ready to take the lead in managing complex fund structures, driving operational excellence, and fostering lasting client relationships? Join Amicorp Fund Services, a trusted global provider of fund administration and corporate services, and play a pivotal role in expanding our fund operations footprint.

About the Role

As Fund Operations Manager, you will ensure Amicorp meets all contractual, regulatory, and statutory obligations while actively supporting commercial growth. You'll oversee the setup and administration of multiple investment funds, manage a dedicated team, and act as a key liaison between clients, investors, and internal departments.

This role blends technical fund expertise, leadership, and a commercial mindset — ideal for someone passionate about both operations and strategic growth.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Deal Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of fund administration clients, fostering long-term, trust-based relationships.
  • Advise on optimal fund structures, legal and regulatory frameworks, and ongoing process improvements.
  • Oversee the drafting and review of commercial, fiscal, and legal documentation.
  • Support fund launches, restructures, and liquidations, ensuring seamless execution and compliance.
  • Attend client and internal meetings to provide technical and operational insights.

Sales & Business Growth

  • Contribute to the commercial growth of Amicorp Fund Services by identifying opportunities and closing deals aligned with business targets.
  • Develop and execute an ambitious sales plan, focusing on expanding relationships with existing clients and attracting new investors.
  • Oversee smooth onboarding and transition management for new clients, ensuring a best-in-class experience.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Collaborate with global accounting teams (India/Mauritius) to deliver accurate and timely fund administration services.
  • Review NAV packages, financial statements, and investor reports to ensure accuracy.
  • Monitor KYC/AML checks, fund compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Maintain comprehensive client records and ensure adherence to all reporting and regulatory requirements.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor the Fund Operations team, ensuring high performance, accountability, and professional growth.
  • Oversee training, performance management, and productivity tracking.
  • Promote standardized procedures, process optimization, and continuous improvement across operations.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree (minimum) with 15+ years of experience in the investment fund industry.
  • Strong professional network within family offices, investment advisers, foreign investors, and the venture capital community.
  • Proven experience managing teams and fund operations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Expertise in fund accounting, NAV calculations, capital calls, audit processes, and tax fund structures.
  • Strong understanding of IFRS / US GAAP and both UCITS and Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs).
  • Excellent client-facing, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Commercially driven, proactive, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Experience with PFX Paxus is an advantage.
  • CGA / CGE certification required.

Why Join Amicorp?

At Amicorp, we believe in empowering our people to lead with purpose, innovate fearlessly, and deliver excellence. You'll work with a global network of experts, gain exposure to diverse jurisdictions, and be part of a company that values integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.

Join us to make a lasting impact in a dynamic and truly international fund services environment.

Ready to elevate your career and lead with impact?

Apply now and become part of Amicorp's global success sto

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management

Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: [TAG] Software Engineer Pleno - ServiceNow
description:
Quem é a Tag?

Na TAG, acreditamos que o conhecimento aplicável é capaz de revolucionar o mercado financeiro e torná-lo mais transparente, acessível e inclusivo. E é por isso que aqui oferecemos soluções tecnológicas para registrar o volume financeiro que o estabelecimento comercial tem a receber pela venda no cartão dos seus produtos e serviços, promovendo o acesso democrático ao crédito e ajudando a fomentar novos negócios por todo o país.

Aqui, você vai trabalhar com um time apaixonado por desafios, que respira tecnologia no dia a dia e é referência no mercado por inovação e expertise. Tudo isso de forma 100% remota, em home office. Quer saber como funciona uma Registradora de Recebíveis? Acesse nosso site.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto

Regime: CLT

O que buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida com Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Actions e GlideRecord.
  • Conhecimento de Flow Designer, IntegrationHub e REST APIs (RESTMessageV2).
  • Capacidade de criar e manter Widgets personalizados no Service Portal (HTML, AngularJS, Client/Server Script).
  • Entendimento de ACLs, roles e segurança de dados.
  • Vivência com CSM, ITSM, com visão de processo e integração.
  • Saber estruturar automação real, não só montar fluxos.
  • Experiência com Workspace / UI Builder (Polaris)
  • Integrações complexas (Slack, Twilio, Datadog, Azure, etc.)
  • Noções de versionamento e boas práticas de governança.
  • Capacidade de propor soluções técnicas e colaborar em projetos de melhoria e automação de processos
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e com vontade de crescer junto com o time.

Nossos benefícios:

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática

Gympass

Auxílio Creche

PLR

Seguro de Vida

Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Avaliação Técnica: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerTager

Aqui na TAG, valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar nesse movimento de transformação do mercado financeiro. Se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente! Caso queira saber mais, siga a TAG no LinkedIn e acompanhe de perto as novidades sobre o mercado de crédito, recebíveis e inovação tecnológica.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we're the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.

Role Overview

We're looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America, partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates' time zone

Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We're building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: Analista de Soluçoes em IA - Sp ou Porto Alegre
description:
Descrição da vaga

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que esperamos que você realize:

Requisitos e qualificações

1. Engenharia de Prompts

  • Capacidade de estruturar prompts de forma clara, objetiva e estratégica para otimizar as respostas geradas por modelos de IA.
  • Compreensão dos princípios de engenharia de prompts, incluindo contexto, instruções detalhadas, exemplos e ajustes iterativos para garantir precisão e relevância nas interações.
  • Capacidade de interpretar requisitos funcionais e técnicos, avaliando a viabilidade da solução.
  • Elaboração de fluxos conversacionais e jornada do usuário com prompts
  • Ter conhecimento de Prompt Chaining/prompts encadeados : Divide tarefas complexas em múltiplos prompts sequenciais
  • Ter conhecimento em criação, teste e ajuste de prompts para executar uma tarefa, atendimento e solução dentro de projetos e curadoria

2. Gestão e Curadoria de Conteúdo

  • Ter conhecimento em estruturação e organização (para melhor processamento e assertividade) de bases de conhecimento para consumo da IA.
  • Avaliação da qualidade das respostas geradas por prompts e refinamento contínuo dos conteúdos.

3. Conhecimento de Ferramentas e Integrações

  • Ter conhecimento para ajustar e interpretar integrações entre essas ferramentas.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com ambientes híbridos e/ou completamente regidos por LLM
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de automação(ex:. ERPs, ITSM, CRM)
  • Ter conhecimento básico de Java Script e JSON

4. Gestão do Conhecimento e Treinamento

  • Ter conhecimento de criação de documentação clara e prática sobre configuração e uso das soluções implantadas.
  • Estudo e testes de novas abordagens alinhadas ao time de produto
  • Treinamento de times internos e clientes sobre boas práticas nas ferramentas e aplicações

5. UX Conversacional & Design de Interação

  • Garantir que as soluções de IA ofereçam interações naturais, intuitivas e eficazes. Conhecimento em análise de logs e feedbacks de usuário.
  • Experiência em design de conversas e fluxos e jornadas conversacionais.

6. Análise de Dados & Dashboards

  • Capacidade de interpretar dados de utilização métricas de engajamento e retenção e satisfação
  • Ter conhecimento em ferramentas de BI e dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Kibana).
  • Identificar falhas e realizar testes de qualidade para resolução ou direcionamento de problemas
  • Traçar planos de ação estratégicos, garantindo que o chatbot evolua de acordo com as necessidades do cliente.
  • Acompanhar a performance da IA do cliente, sugerindo ajustes contínuos.

7. Relacionamento e Atendimento ao Cliente

  • Apresentar relatórios analíticos sobre utilização da solução e planos de ação com insights estratégicos
  • Coletar feedbacks e traduzir as necessidades do cliente em melhorias na solução.
  • Capacidade de comunicar insights técnicos e estratégicos de forma clara. Experiência na apresentação de relatórios e sugestões de melhoria.
  • Habilidade para negociar e alinhar expectativas com clientes e stakeholders.

Informações adicionais

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

title: Coordenador(a) de Food Safety (Temporário)
description:
About the role

Estamos buscando um(a) Coordenador(a) de Food Safety para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, garantindo a implementação e manutenção dos programas de qualidade e segurança de alimentos na fábrica. Contrato temporário de 9 meses com chance de contratação ao final do contrato.

Key responsibilities

  • Garantir a implementação e manutenção dos programas de Food Safety e Qualidade na fábrica.
  • Promover treinamentos de HACCP para equipe HACCP e demais colaboradores.
  • Coordenar o manejo integrado de pragas.
  • Elaborar, implementar e registrar treinamentos da área de qualidade para todos os colaboradores.
  • Revisar e manter todos os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP) da fábrica.
  • Atuar frente às não conformidades encontradas, utilizando ferramentas como 5W2H para análise de causa raiz.
  • Coordenar auditorias internas e externas, bem como planos de ação decorrentes de auditorias, reclamações de clientes ou não conformidades.
  • Gerenciar o sistema de reclamações de clientes.
  • Liderar a equipe HACCP e revisar estudos HACCP.
  • Garantir conformidade com normas governamentais, ambientais e de segurança industrial.

Qualifications and skills

  • Formação preferencial: Engenharia de Alimentos, Química ou Farmácia.
  • Certificações: HACCP, FSSC 22000 (obrigatória).
  • Experiência com auditorias internas e externas (relacionados à qualidade e segurança de alimentos).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de causa raiz (5W2H).
  • Domínio de SAP e Excel (planilhas de capex, budget).
  • Conhecimento em sistemas globais e protocolos internacionais.
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura de documentação técnica e protocolos globais). Espanhol será considerado diferencial.
  • Pensamento crítico e capacidade analítica.
  • Inteligência emocional para lidar com problemas e manter a calma.
  • Proatividade, resiliência e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade de priorizar tarefas em ambiente dinâmico.
  • Visão prática: presença no chão de fábrica, não apenas atividades administrativas.

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're Flowmentum and our clients are fast-moving teams building reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure for companies shaping the future of AI, fintech, cloud services, and beyond.

Our engineers work on high-traffic, mission-critical systems that power millions of users across the globe.

We believe in autonomy, ownership, and solving hard problems — at scale. If you're passionate about infrastructure done right, we want you on the team.

  • Design and deploy cloud-native systems on AWS, that just work — at scale.

description:

title: MBRAS Partner - Consultor Imobiliário de Alto Padrão
description:
Consultor Imobiliário de Alto Padrão (Programa PARTNERS MBRAS)

Localização: São Paulo, Capital

Sobre a MBRAS

A MBRAS é líder no mercado imobiliário de altíssimo padrão em São Paulo desde 2010. Reconhecida por sua inovação e excelência, a empresa oferece experiências imobiliárias exclusivas, consultoria especializada e gestão de ativos para uma clientela selecionada.

Sobre o Programa MBRAS Partners

Estamos lançando o MBRAS Partners, uma iniciativa que proporciona a profissionais experientes a oportunidade de ingressar ou evoluir no mercado imobiliário de luxo atuando em parceria com a marca líder MBRAS. title: Business Intelligence Partner
description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil

about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.

job context

and purpose

Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the 'BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.

Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients

Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client's data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met

job

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree a plus

Mandatory Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience
  • MI/Business Intelligence/Data Science/Analytics background
  • Proficient with an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to turn ambiguous information and unstructured challenges into substantive insights.

Preferred Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Industry exposure to business process outsourcing and/or workforce planning (e.g., MSP/RPO)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills required for various levels throughout external and internal organizations
  • Excellent presentation skills used in delivering solutions to executive-level clients
  • Demonstrated continuous improvement, process documentation, and workflow skills
  • Excellent working knowledge of MS - Excel with knowledge of macros and pivot tables.
  • Excellent working knowledge of Google products, and visualization tools Tableau, etc.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, tasks, and meet deadlines while maintaining quality
  • Ability to synthesize and analyze information and ideas
  • Strong drive and commitment to delivering outstanding results
  • Have the ability to provide value with the use of analytics to help achieve the account's objectives and the client's initiatives.
  • Ability to create meaningful insights and metrics that aligned to business priorities and objectives
  • Data visualization preferred; ability to interpret data and translate it to non-tech people.
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to write Intermediate SQL scripts
  • Experience in data pipeline creation, quality improvement and analysis to provide teams with actionable insights, informing strategy, impact and investments.
  • Experience with analytics tools.
  • Extensive experience in technical client service (i.e. consulting experience).
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail and a well-organized, structured approach to work.
  • Must be fluent in English.

This position will require a live SQL Assessment.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world's leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we've defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What's yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package
  • Paid Time Off
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate's education, experience, skills and potential.

  • Gerir, orientar e desenvolver a equipe, alinhando tarefas e apoiando no crescimento profissional de cada associado(a);

  • Garantir conformidade com políticas e procedimentos, assegurando que todos os processos estejam alinhados com as diretrizes institucionais e requisitos legais;
  • Realizar a gestão financeira, desde o fluxo de caixa, despesas operacionais e demais indicadores financeiros, garantindo a saúde financeira da loja;
  • Controlar o estoque, mantendo a organização de produtos, evitando faltas ou excessos, garantindo que esteja sempre atualizado, ajudando a manter o bom funcionamento da loja;
  • Auxiliar na operação de loja através das rotinas operacionais, como atendimento ao cliente, organização, reposição e suporte ao caixa;
  • Planejar as estratégias de venda desenvolvendo ações com base em análises de mercado, sazonalidade e comportamento do cliente, buscando resultados positivos e aumento da competitividade da loja;
  • Conduzir o processo de recrutamento e seleção para cargos operacionais de loja, garantindo o alinhamento entre o perfil buscado e os valores da cia;
  • Garantir o cuidado e conservação do patrimônio da cia, promovendo a conservação dos equipamentos e recursos para a segurança do ambiente de trabalho.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Graduação Completa;
  • Conhecimento do pacote office;
  • Habilidade analítica e estratégica;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Perfil direcionado a resultados;
  • Senso de urgência.

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Excel intermediário.

  • Regime CLT e benefícios abrangentes, como Vale Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco e Plano Odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub, promovendo bem-estar e qualidade de vida;
  • Seguro de vida, garantindo proteção para você e sua família;
  • Licenças estendidas: Somos uma Empresa Cidadã, com 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias de licença paternidade. Um tempo a mais para cuidar de quem mais importa - nosso futuro;
  • Descontos exclusivos nas nossas lojas físicas após o período de experiência, conectando você ainda mais aos nossos produtos e serviços;
  • Plataforma interna repleta de cursos e treinamentos que impulsionam sua trajetória profissional;
  • Ambiente colaborativo e inclusivo, perfeito para ensinar, aprender e se desenvolver tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente.

Nosso impacto vai além:

Cada dia na Americanas é uma oportunidade de transformar desafios em soluções; ideias em realizações. Estamos comprometidos em fazer a diferença, cuidando das nossas pessoas e contribuindo para um impacto positivo não só para os nossos stakeholders, mas para toda a sociedade.

Se você quer fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza a autenticidade, a inovação e o trabalho coletivo, venha fazer parte da Americanas S.A. Aqui, crescemos juntos, resolvemos a vida de milhões e criamos histórias que inspiram.

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Guarantã do Norte/MT.

  • Entrevista com área de Gente
  • Entrevista com Gestão
  • Proposta
  • Contratação

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative (Brazil)
description:

Com uma carteira de clientes em rápido crescimento, estamos expandindo nosso time de geração de pipeline país por país — agora é a vez do Brasil.

Sua missão

Gerar um fluxo previsível de marcas brasileiras de porte médio a enterprise, abrir relacionamento com líderes de Marketing (nível C-Level) e construir oportunidades de negócio qualificadas para o time de vendas da Hellotext.

O que você fará

  • Planejar e executar cadências outbound multicanal (Apollo, LinkedIn, telefone, WhatsApp).
  • Visitar escritórios de marcas-chave em São Paulo, Rio, BH, Porto Alegre ou outras praças estratégicas.
  • Criar narrativas de negócio que ressoem com CMOs e VPs de e-commerce.
  • Colaborar com Produto e Marketing para transformar insights de mercado em novas funcionalidades.
  • Medir tudo: taxas de abertura, reply, conversão e ROI de cada campanha.

O que você traz

  • 2–5 anos como SDR/BDR ou AE vendendo SaaS/MarTech para varejo ou e-commerce.
  • Histórico comprovado de geração de pipeline (reuniões + valor) no mercado brasileiro.
  • Português nativo e inglês intermediário-avançado; domínio diário de Apollo e HubSpot (ou ferramentas equivalentes).
  • Zero medo de telefone e disponibilidade para viajar ≈ 25 % dentro do Brasil.

Diferenciais (nice-to-have)

  • Negócios fechados ≥ USD 30 k ARR.
  • Rede de contatos C-Level em varejo/e-commerce.
  • Experiência mentorando SDRs júnior.

Competências que valorizamos

  • Prospeção magistral – cold-calling sem desculpas.
  • Storytelling C-Suite – transforma dados em narrativas claras e convincentes.
  • Criatividade consultiva – desenha ativações sob medida para marcas top.
  • Propriedade de pipeline – trata a meta como quota, não só KPI.
  • Mentalidade de aprendiz – itera, faz A/B tests, compartilha playbooks.

description:

Experiência com práticas de DevOps e infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou AWS CloudFormation. Habilidade para resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente e colaborativa. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas. Diferenciais: Certificações AWS, como AWS Certified Developer ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Conhecimento em segurança na nuvem e boas práticas de proteção de dados. Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful. Contribuições para projetos open source ou participação em comunidades técnicas.

• Conhecimento em Vue.js, Astro e TypeScript avançado.

• Integração com backend e APIs (REST/GraphQL) e noções de fullstack (Node.js ou Laravel).

• Participação no desenvolvimento de Design Systems.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.

You'll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.

This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.

We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.

Who are we?

BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America, and we are now expanding our legal team in China.

What you will do:

  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.

What we expect from you:

  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.

What We Offer

  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We're building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.

Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who'll make it happen.

title: Latin America Finance Business Partner - Sales & Marketing and Field Operations
description:
Latin America Finance Business Partner - Sales & Marketing and Field Operations

Role Overview:

We are seeking a proactive, dynamic and hands-on Finance Business Partner to support our Sales & Marketing and Field Operations teams across the Latin America region. This is a high-impact role where you will play a critical part in driving business performance, offering strategic financial insights, and providing actionable recommendations to enable growth and operational efficiency. You will be the key finance partner for these teams, working closely with Latam senior leadership to track field and sales performance, and ensure that business goals are met within budget.

On a typical day you will:

  • Strategic Financial Partnering: Serve as a trusted partner to Sales & Marketing and Field Operations teams, working on the databases and providing financial insights that drive decision-making and support business strategies.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting: Lead the budgeting and forecasting process for Sales & Marketing and Field Operations organizations. Develop and maintain rolling forecasts, track budget variances, and ensure financial targets are aligned with operational goals.
  • Business Performance Analysis: Analyze financial data and key performance metrics for both Sales & Marketing and Field Operations. Provide insights into revenue generation, profitability, and cost control, helping to optimize spending and improve financial outcomes.
  • Cost Management & Efficiency: Collaborate with operational leaders to identify areas for cost reduction, process improvements, and operational efficiencies within the sales and field operations domains.
  • Financial Reporting: Prepare regular financial reports and presentations for senior management, highlighting key trends, risks, and opportunities in the business. Present clear, actionable recommendations based on financial analysis.
  • KPIs and Metrics: Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor the success of sales and marketing campaigns and field operations. Ensure alignment with business objectives and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with world headquarters in Finance, Sales & Marketing, and Field Operations, fostering collaboration and ensuring alignment between financial and operational goals.
  • Ad Hoc Financial Support: Provide ad-hoc financial analysis and support as needed for special projects, strategic initiatives, and decision-making processes.

What You Will Need to be Successful:

  • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in business administration, Accounting, Economics or Engineering (MBA or professional finance qualification preferred).
  • Fluent English and Spanish. Strong interaction with Latin America countries and headquarters in the United States, through conference calls and in person meetings.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in managerial roles as finance business partnering, and/or financial planning & analysis, ideally with experience in Sales & Marketing and/or Operations environments.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data, draw insights, and make strategic recommendations.
  • Business Acumen: Understanding of sales, marketing, and field operations metrics and the ability to translate these into actionable financial strategies.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial data in a clear and compelling way to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Advanced Excel skills (including financial modeling) and Hyperion Financial Management (HFM) Oracle Hyperion Financial Management.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work cross-functionally with various business units and senior leadership to influence decision-making.
  • Problem Solving: Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying financial trends and issues.
